title: Understanding Cerebral Palsy
artStyle: 2D cartoon for a friendly educational video: bold dark outlines, flat bright colours with simple cel shading, rounded shapes and big expressive eyes

characters.name: Dr. Asha
characters.look: A friendly Indian woman doctor in her forties with brown skin, black hair in a low bun and round glasses, wearing a white coat over a teal kurta, with a stethoscope around her neck.

characters.name: Meera
characters.look: An Indian mother in her thirties with warm brown skin and a long black plait, wearing a mustard yellow salwar kameez with a pink dupatta.
characters.voiceStyle: Caring, worried at first, then relieved

characters.name: Aarav
characters.look: A cheerful six-year-old Indian boy with brown skin and short black hair, wearing a red T-shirt and blue shorts, standing with a small blue children's walker that he holds with both hands.

locations.name: Home
locations.look: A cosy living room in an Indian home with a sofa, a window with curtains and a patterned rug.

locations.name: Clinic
locations.look: A bright children's clinic room with a desk, a height chart on the wall and a potted plant.

locations.name: Park
locations.look: A sunny neighbourhood park with green grass, trees, a path and a blue sky with soft clouds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meera has just heard two new words: cerebral palsy.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: What does this mean for my son?

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Cerebral palsy, or CP, affects how a child moves and balances.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: It begins in the developing brain, before or around birth.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: No. It is nobody's fault, and it is not contagious.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Every child with CP is different.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Some walk on their own. Some use a walker or a wheelchair.

lines.speaker: c3
lines.text: My walker helps me go where I want!

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Starting therapy early helps children build strength and skills.

lines.speaker: c3
lines.text: I practise every day. Watch me!

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: He goes to school, plays and makes friends.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: With love and support, every child can shine.
